import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem second_countable_subspace_trace_basis {K : Type*} [MetricSpace K]
    [SecondCountableTopology K] {A : Set K} :
    ∃ (B : Set (Set K)), Set.Countable B ∧
      (∀ U ∈ B, IsOpen U) ∧
      TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis
        (Set.image (fun U : Set K => (Subtype.val : A → K) ⁻¹' U) B) ∧
      (∀ x y : A, x ≠ y → ∃ U ∈ B,
        x ∈ (Subtype.val : A → K) ⁻¹' U ∧
        y ∉ (Subtype.val : A → K) ⁻¹' U) := by
  obtain ⟨B, hBc, _, hB⟩ := TopologicalSpace.exists_countable_basis K
  refine
    ⟨B, hBc, ?_,
      hB.isInducing (⟨rfl⟩ : IsInducing (Subtype.val : A → K)), ?_⟩
  · intro U hU
    exact hB.isOpen hU
  · intro x y hxy
    have hval : (x : K) ≠ (y : K) := by
      intro h
      exact hxy (Subtype.ext h)
    have hopen : IsOpen (({(y : K)} : Set K)ᶜ) :=
      (isClosed_singleton : IsClosed ({(y : K)} : Set K)).isOpen_compl
    have hxopen : (x : K) ∈ ({(y : K)} : Set K)ᶜ := by
      simpa [Set.mem_compl_iff, hval]
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, hUsub⟩ :=
      hB.exists_subset_of_mem_open hxopen hopen
    refine ⟨U, hU, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hxU
    · intro hyU
      have hyU' : (y : K) ∈ U := hyU
      have hycomp : (y : K) ∈ ({(y : K)} : Set K)ᶜ :=
        hUsub hyU'
      exact hycomp (by simp)
